coverage_assessment: Bounded open-web first pass: 12 actual individually captured search calls and 282 aligned result headers. French and English searches covered date windows 1–7, 8–14, 15–21 and 22–31 March, Port-Louis, Rodrigues, regional terms, political demonstrations, public-service/health/education/transport and union/labor leads. Three candidates remain pending: March 18 attendance is approximate around 50; March 3 attendance does not establish the threshold; a March 17 FPU lead is search-only after an exact PDF 403. This is not exhaustive and does not imply no further protests.
